page0.text:
...I'm more worried about Sakura.
I need to make that clear to Tohsaka, even if I feel guilty about it.

page1.text:
"Tohsaka. Can we do that at my place?"
"Home? You mean your house?"

page2.text: "Yeah. Sakura has a cold, so I need to look after her. If I'm going to be staying over here a few nights, then I can't rest easy unless I check in on her beforehand."

page3.text:
"Oh, crap. You're right."
...She's fed up with me.
Of course she would be. I came to her for help, and here I am saying I want to go home because it doesn't fit my schedule—

page4.text:
"You idiot! If you'd said that sooner, I wouldn't have kept you here so long!"
"...Wha?"
She jolts to her feet, storms over to the coat rack, and dons her coat.

page5.text:
"Let's go. I've done what we came to do, and we can finish the rest at your house. We'll pick this up once you take care of Sakura, so hurry up and get home."
"Uh...y-yeah. I appreciate that."

page6.text:
"Hmph! Also, I might forget to say it later, so I'll tell you this now.
Your real specialty isn't Strengthening, but Projection.
I don't know when or how you mixed that up, but you're supposed to be a mage who creates things."
Tohsaka walks briskly down the hallway.
